title: Asbab al-Nuzul
author: al-wahidi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Wahidi's collection of reports on the occasions that prompted particular Qur'anic verses, arranged surah by surah. It is one of the earliest surviving works devoted to the genre and a standard source for narrative context.
historicalContext: Compiled in Nishapur in the eleventh century from earlier exegetical and historical reports. Later authors, including al-Suyuti, depended on it for the occasions of revelation.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
